page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ine.xlarge is an x86_64 server instance belonging to the Enhanced family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on a KVM hypervisor. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. No local storage is bundled with the instance, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements.

Network infrastructure capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps. The instance does not include dedicated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because hardware accelerators and direct-attached storage disks are absent, workload deployments rely on external cloud storage volumes over the network interface.

With its 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, ecs.g8ine.xlarge provides balanced resource density suitable for horizontal scaling without incurring the overhead of unused local disk arrays or GPU silicon. Typical workload fits include standard enterprise web applications, microservices, continuous integration tasks, containerized application runtimes, and intermediate relational database instances.
